name: @activepieces/piece-jungle-grid
description: Submit async compute jobs, monitor status and logs, and retrieve artifacts from Jungle Grid.

auth.description: Connect with a scoped Jungle Grid API key. Use the default API base URL unless your workspace provides a custom endpoint.

api_base_url.description: Base URL for the Jungle Grid API. Keep the default unless Jungle Grid provides a specific endpoint for your workspace.

api_key.description: Paste a scoped Jungle Grid API key from the Jungle Grid portal.

estimate_job.name: estimate_job
estimate_job.description: Estimate the cost, duration, and resources for a Jungle Grid job.

instructions.description:
### Async workflow

1. Run **Estimate Job** to preview route, queue, and cost signals.
2. Run **Submit Job** to queue work. This returns immediately with the Jungle Grid job status.
3. Add a Delay, branch, or loop, then call **Get Job Status**, **Get Job Runtime**, or **Get Job Logs**.
4. After completion, call **List Job Artifacts** and **Get Artifact Download URL** if the job produced files.

name.description: Optional human-readable label for this Jungle Grid job.

workload_type.description: The workload class Jungle Grid should route.

image.description: Public container image reference, for example `python:3.11` or `pytorch/pytorch:2.4.0-cuda12.1-cudnn9-runtime`.

model_size_gb.description: Approximate model size in GB. Jungle Grid uses this for routing and cost estimation.

command.description: Container command to run. Leave blank to use the image default entrypoint or command.

args.description: Optional command arguments, one item per argument.

optimize_for.description: Placement preference for cost, speed, or balanced routing.

max_price_per_hour.description: Optional maximum hourly price in USD.

preferred_gpu_family.description: Optional GPU family preference, for example `l4`.

avoid_gpu_families.description: Optional GPU families to avoid, one item per family, for example `a100`.

aiMetadata.description: Compute a cost, duration, and resource estimate for a prospective Jungle Grid job from the same specification used by Submit Job, without actually running anything. Pick this to preview or budget-check a job before submission; it is a safe, idempotent calculation with no side effects. Use Submit Job afterwards to actually execute.

submit_job.name: submit_job
submit_job.description: Submit a Jungle Grid job and return immediately with job metadata. This action does not wait for completion.

image.description: Public container image reference, for example `python:3.11` or `pytorch/pytorch:2.4.0-cuda12.1-cudnn9-runtime`.

args.description: Optional command arguments, one item per argument.

optimize_for.description: Placement preference for cost, speed, or balanced routing.

max_price_per_hour.description: Optional maximum hourly price in USD.

preferred_gpu_family.description: Optional GPU family preference, for example `l4`.

avoid_gpu_families.description: Optional GPU families to avoid, one item per family, for example `a100`.

callback_url.description: Optional HTTPS callback URL for terminal job lifecycle events.

callback_metadata.description: Optional key-value metadata Jungle Grid should include with callback events.

aiMetadata.description: Submit a new Jungle Grid job for asynchronous execution; it returns immediately with job metadata and does not wait for completion, so poll with Get Job Status afterwards. Pick this to actually run a workload (use Estimate Job first to preview cost). Not idempotent: each call creates a new job, so retries can launch duplicates.

list_jobs.name: list_jobs
list_jobs.description: List Jungle Grid jobs for the authenticated workspace, optionally filtered by status.

limit.description: Maximum number of jobs to return. Jungle Grid accepts 1 to 100.

cursor.description: Optional cursor from a previous List Jobs response.

aiMetadata.description: List jobs in the authenticated Jungle Grid workspace, optionally filtered by status, with cursor-based pagination up to 100 per page. Pick this to find a job ID when none is known or to survey recent activity; if you already have a job ID, Get Job Status is more direct. Read-only and idempotent.

get_job_status.name: get_job_status
get_job_status.description: Get the current status and metadata for a submitted Jungle Grid job.

job_id.description: The `job_id` returned by Submit Job or List Jobs.

aiMetadata.description: Look up the current lifecycle status and metadata of a Jungle Grid job by job ID. Pick this as the standard poll after Submit Job to check whether a job is queued, running, or finished; for exit codes and log tails use Get Job Runtime, and for output files use List Job Artifacts. Read-only and idempotent.

get_job_runtime.name: get_job_runtime
get_job_runtime.description: Get runtime tails, exit code, and runtime availability details for a Jungle Grid job.

job_id.description: The `job_id` returned by Submit Job or List Jobs.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve runtime execution details for a Jungle Grid job by job ID, including log tails, exit code, and whether runtime data is available. Pick this to diagnose how a job actually ran; use Get Job Status for lifecycle state only, or Get Job Logs for fuller paginated log output. Read-only and idempotent.

get_job_logs.name: get_job_logs
get_job_logs.description: Get recent stdout, stderr, or combined logs for a submitted Jungle Grid job.

job_id.description: The `job_id` returned by Submit Job or List Jobs.

tail_lines.description: Number of recent log lines to fetch. Jungle Grid accepts 1 to 500.

cursor.description: Optional `next_cursor` from a previous logs response.

stream.description: Choose which log stream to fetch.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch recent log lines for a Jungle Grid job by job ID, choosing stdout, stderr, or both, with a tail of up to 500 lines and cursor-based paging for more. Pick this to debug a failing job or inspect output text; for structured status or exit-code details use Get Job Status or Get Job Runtime instead. Read-only and idempotent.

list_artifacts.name: list_artifacts
list_artifacts.description: List files produced by a Jungle Grid job when managed artifact storage is available.

job_id.description: The `job_id` returned by Submit Job or List Jobs.

aiMetadata.description: List the output files (artifacts) produced by a Jungle Grid job, by job ID. Pick this after a job completes to discover what it produced, then use Get Artifact Download URL to fetch a specific file; only works when the workspace has managed artifact storage. Read-only and idempotent.

get_artifact_download_url.name: get_artifact_download_url
get_artifact_download_url.description: Create a temporary signed download URL for a Jungle Grid artifact. Treat the returned URL as a secret.

job_id.description: The `job_id` returned by Submit Job or List Jobs.

artifact_id.description: The artifact ID returned by List Job Artifacts.

aiMetadata.description: Generate a short-lived signed download URL for one artifact of a Jungle Grid job, given the job ID and artifact ID. Pick this after List Job Artifacts when a file actually needs to be downloaded; calling it is safe to repeat (each call just issues a fresh temporary URL), but the URL expires and must be treated as a secret.

cancel_job.name: cancel_job
cancel_job.description: Cancel a non-terminal Jungle Grid job. This may stop active execution.

job_id.description: The `job_id` returned by Submit Job or List Jobs.

reason.description: Optional cancellation reason stored with the Jungle Grid job status.

aiMetadata.description: Request cancellation of a running or queued Jungle Grid job by job ID, optionally recording a reason. Pick this to stop a job that is no longer needed; it mutates job state and only applies to jobs that have not already reached a terminal status. Not idempotent: retrying against an already-cancelled or finished job may fail.
